# Decoding the genetics of the human heart.

<p class="lede">We combine human genetics, functional genomics, and experimental models to understand how molecular variation shapes cardiac disease—and to uncover new opportunities for intervention.</p>

[Explore our research](research.qmd){.action-link}
:::

<div class="section-kicker">What we study</div>

## Our approach

We work across human cardiac tissues, single-cell and spatial genomics, long-read sequencing, chromatin architecture, and experimental perturbation to connect genetic association with biological mechanism.

[Meet the team](people.qmd) · [Explore publications](publications.qmd) · [Join the lab](contact.qmd)
